description: Header file defining the implementation of a PDCP entity class, including its constructor, destructor, and interface methods, as well as private members for managing PDCP transmission and reception components.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for PDCP entity handling transmission and reception, with methods for control interfaces, stopping, and managing internal components.

methods.name: pdcp_entity_impl
methods.description: Constructor initializing PDCP entity with configuration, notifiers, timers, and executors.

methods.name: ~pdcp_entity_impl
methods.description: Destructor that stops the PDCP entity.

methods.name: get_tx_upper_control_interface
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper control interface for transmission.

methods.name: get_tx_upper_data_interface
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper data interface for transmission.

methods.name: get_tx_lower_interface
methods.description: Returns reference to the lower interface for transmission.

methods.name: get_rx_upper_control_interface
methods.description: Returns reference to the upper control interface for reception.

methods.name: get_rx_lower_interface
methods.description: Returns reference to the lower interface for reception.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the PDCP entity, halting timers and transmission/reception components.

methods.name: tx_crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns the event flag for transmission crypto operations.

methods.name: rx_crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns the event flag for reception crypto operations.
